body_markdown:
What if, instead of just listening to your favorite podcast, you got to hang out inside it? That’s exactly what three superfans got to experience last month at the ultimate


[Friends Keep Secrets](https://open.spotify.com/show/2SUiKdJUpof6jSfDlQ4rB1) dinner party. Hosts


[benny blanco](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5CiGnKThu5ctn9pBxv7DGa) ,


**Dave Burd** (aka


[Lil Dicky](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1tqhsYv8yBBdwANFNzHtcr) ), and his wife,


**Kristin Batalucco** , invited the fans to Dave and Kristin’s Los Angeles home to whip up dinner with a side of show trivia, good conversations, and lots of laughs.


*Friends Keep Secrets* blends elements of a podcast, livestream, and sitcom into one laid-back hang. Guests from rap superstar


[Lil Wayne](https://open.spotify.com/artist/55Aa2cqylxrFIXC767Z865) to


[Gwyneth Paltrow](https://open.spotify.com/episode/5bW8BydqJuLt4k1GPrRQXt?si=78253ea6096144cf) pop by, and what happens next is up to them. They might cook, record a song, play a game, or just talk as hidden cameras set up throughout the house capture every moment.


In many ways, the house itself is an integral part of the show. “When you’re in someone’s house, regardless of whether there’s cameras around, you just kind of fall into a comfort that doesn’t exist anywhere else,” benny said. “When you have someone over, they take their shoes off, they hang out, and they’re more likely to become the version of themselves that they are when they’re at home. That’s what we wanted to do originally with this podcast.”


NEXT


Before the superfans stopped by for dinner,


*For the Record* caught up with Dave and Kristin to talk about the inspiration behind the show and whether either of them has a secret to spill.


### **One of the thrills of** ***Friends Keep Secrets*** **is seeing you and your guests in the intimacy of your home. What was the inspiration behind that?**


**Dave:** We wanted to create something that truly felt like people hanging out. The best way to do that is to avoid a set, and the show becomes even more real and comfortable when we invite people into our actual home.


### **How do you think taping at home shapes conversations you have with your guests?**


**Kristin:** It’s instantly cozy and disarming to be in someone’s home. People forget that they’re being filmed when they aren’t on a set, and that allows them to just live in the moment and open up more in an authentic way.


### **What are you most looking forward to fans seeing or experiencing during the taping?**


**Dave:** Sitting by the fire, opening the fridge for a drink, all of the small, everyday things that we do without thinking about. We’re excited to see people behave like they are just coming over to our house—because they are!


### **When was the last time you kept a secret from each other? Are either of you keeping a secret** ***right now??***


**Dave:** We’re all pretty trustworthy people, but we all keep secrets, some big, some small. We can’t tell you because that would defeat the purpose of them being secrets!


*Watch the Quality Time with Friends Keep Secrets episode, available now on Spotify’s*[Between Episodes](https://open.spotify.com/show/03u3CF5jy51WnvG1ry77gA?si=f0209941b28e41cb) *podcast.*
